review_scope: current v4 paid-path load-generator sanity guards and retained-engine handoff
findings: The controller emits one fixed GPU0-only 12-rps guard followed by one fixed GPU0-only 15-rps guard; it contains neither an adaptive probe selector nor a two-GPU capacity probe.

The generic capacity verdict is deliberately ignored for the three-second stale-calibration guards, while cadence, routing, monotonic timestamps, output accounting, queue-flow conservation, TTFT, completion rate, queue slope, and maximum backlog remain fail-closed.

Both workers emit and the controller validates reset evidence after each guard. A second reset is required before the immutable transaction command; worker-side object identity checks prove that this does not reload either engine.

The 15-rps guard accepts only a predeclared overload signal (queue slope above 0.10 requests/s, completed rate below offered rate, or p95 TTFT above 100 ms) and rejects any maximum backlog above 25 requests.

The transaction trigger is fixed at queue depth 20 with positive queue slope, and the pre-GPU config and Modal model both pin a hard scientific abort at depth 25. The overload phase now has a 22-second evidence-derived upper bound without weakening either threshold.

GPU1 restore eligibility is not inferred from the Python driver alone: the paid worker supplies the live vLLM scheduler state, and the serving path requires the exact five-field state to report zero requests, running, waiting, skipped-waiting, and queue depth.

The v4 config is locally validated against the sealed authorization and hash-bound phase budget, fixes seed 41, fixes each measurement window to three seconds, binds the established 12/15/20-rps load points, and reserves exactly 469 wall seconds or 938 A100-seconds before Modal allocation.

manual_validation.forbidden_paid_path_symbols_search: PASS: no external_review, recommend_next_probe, maximum_probes, rate_grid_rps, or 10-second capacity-measurement fields occur in the current v4 controller/worker/Modal/config paid path

historical_scope_note: The superseded v1/v2/v3 artifacts remain immutable historical evidence; all review hashes, tests, and budget statements in this decision bind only the current exp004-v10-naive-s41-v4 paid path.
approval_statement: The current v4 load-generator sanity path is suitable for one preauthorized integrated v10 transaction. This approval does not authorize broad calibration, additional seeds, GPU retries, or any live reviewer wait.
